analogs.covers: Life: Gobi desert nomad, salt needs, goes long without water, herd around a lead bull
Family: extreme calf devotion, orphan adoption, unbothered bulk that walks vast distances to minerals

headline: A Gobi camel herd with an elephant mother's heart: a salt-hungry desert nomad that barely notices carnivores.

setting.label: Arid, desert-roaming nomad
setting.note: Primarily arid-dwelling. Travels vast distances to Salt Rocks, can go long without water, and the herd stands shoulder to shoulder in the midday heat of the dry season.

playsLike: You are an Apex hadrosaur in a family herd of up to 10, led by a lead male or an elder female. Carnivores barely register unless they hunt you or come near calves. Salt is your fuel: sub-adults and adults must reach Salt Rocks regularly or suffer hyponatremia. Nests and food sources are defended fiercely.

why.text: Kidneys built for salt, needs Salt Rocks, may substitute salt water and goes long without drinking. Wild Bactrian camels survive on salty water in the Gobi, where Barsboldia itself was found.
Harem bonds and herds of up to 10 led by a lead male or elder female. Wild camel herds likewise centre on one breeding bull.
In the midday dry-season heat the herd stands packed side by side, a desert animal's heat strategy.
Every member loves the calves, and a mother who loses hers adopts the first orphan she meets. Elephants are famous for shared calf care and taking in orphans.
Apex tier, 5,500 combat weight, 1,500 HP, with 2 defenders. When Tyrannosaurus hunts a herd with no young, the herd flees and leaves the victim undefended.

notLike: Camels are not territorial; Barsboldia defends nests and food sources.
Sprint stamina is short (50 s), so it cannot run far.
